info.title: ShareOut API (agent essentials)
info.summary: Publish, serve, and manage live web artifacts.
info.description: The small set of ShareOut calls an AI agent needs to publish pages for a person: check the key, list workspaces, publish, check a published page (verify), find and update pages, and ask the ShareOut team for help. Errors carry `code`, `hint` and `request_id`; on a 5xx or when stuck, create a support ticket quoting the request_id. Full spec: /openapi.json.

get.description: The account this API key belongs to. Call it first to check the key works; a 401 here means reconnect (see the error `hint`).

post.description: Create a new artifact or push a new version of an existing one. Every `files[].path` must be a safe relative path (see `FileEntry.path`); an unsafe one returns 400 `INVALID_PATH` with a `hint` naming it.

201.description: Published. Check `visibility` — when it is more private than asked, `visibility_downgraded` is true and `notice` says why; tell the user.

parameters.name: favorites
parameters.description: Return only the current user's favorited artifacts.

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: List artifacts that belong to a workspace (not the caller's personal artifacts). Caller must be a workspace member (403 otherwise). Owners/admins see all workspace artifacts; members see non-private artifacts plus any they own or collaborate on.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Set `true` to include an exact `total` (extra query).

get.description: The path also accepts the artifact's slug. Any signed-in caller who can view the artifact gets its details; `can_edit`, `can_delete` and `can_manage_comments` say which writes the API will accept from this caller.

patch.description: Update visibility, name, social link-preview fields, or anonymous-access opt-ins. When instance policy holds public visibility the write still succeeds with 202 `VISIBILITY_HELD` (or `MODERATION_HELD` while an automated safety check runs) and the page stays private for now.

allow_anon_write.description: Let anonymous visitors mutate json/tables/blobs/datasets on public artifacts.

allow_anon_email.description: Let anonymous visitors send contact-form email.

allow_anon_agent.description: Let anonymous visitors use the in-artifact AI chat agent.

allow_anon_collab.description: Let anonymous visitors join realtime collaboration.

post.summary: Verify — what viewers see and what broke
post.description: Opens the page the way its viewers get it — on its content origin, in a fresh browser with no ShareOut session, with the viewer sandbox emulated (storage, cookies and IndexedDB throw `SecurityError`) and the viewer's Content-Security-Policy enforced — on a 1280×800 desktop and a 390×844 phone, and reports script errors (with file:line:col), failed requests (with the `code`/`hint` of ShareOut API errors), blocked CDNs, accessibility (axe-core, WCAG 2.1 A/AA), horizontal overflow, tap targets under 44 px, broken images, blank screens, design lint, LCP/CLS/bytes and common source mistakes. Writes the page makes on load are refused (read-only render). The phone view renders the version's mobile entrypoint when it has one, and a pinned `version` is rendered entirely from that version's files. Verifying the live version also refreshes the thumbnail. Owners and editors only; workspace Agent tokens need `artifacts:publish`. Limited per user per hour (30 unless the instance sets `VERIFY_RUNS_PER_HOUR`). Without a Browser Rendering binding the result is `partial` (source checks only). Typical run: 5–15 s.

200.description: The verify run (also stored as the latest)

409.description: Nothing to render — not published yet (`NOT_PUBLISHED`), paused or taken down

get.description: The most recent verify result for this page (only the latest run is kept). Owners and editors only. 404 `NO_VERIFY_RUN` until the first verify.

Typo-tolerant search across pages, folders, datasets, connectors, people, schedules, crew, and alerts. Same engine as the Home Cmd+K palette. Personal tokens may pass `workspace` to scope; workspace Agent tokens (`sot_`) are pinned to their workspace and require `artifacts:read`.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: Workspace id to scope (personal tokens only).

workspaceId.description: Must be a workspace the caller belongs to (else 403).

requestId.description: request_id from the error response that led here.

idempotencyKey.description: Same key from the same account returns the original ticket (200, deduped=true).

get.description: `scope=mine` (default) returns the requester's tickets. `scope=workspace&workspace={id}` requires workspace admin/owner. `scope=all` is instance-admin only (session or personal token; workspace agent tokens are refused) and also filters by `workspace` (`none` = no workspace), `category`, `since` and `limit`. Optional `status` filter.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: Required when scope=workspace. With scope=all, a workspace id or `none`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: scope=all only. Tickets with a message after this ISO timestamp.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit reached (`RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` on publish / account creation / AI routes, `RATE_LIMITED` on the data plane). Wait for `Retry-After` / `reset`.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server failure. Retry once; if it fails again, file a ticket with `POST /v1/support/tickets` quoting `request_id`.

access_policy.description: Row-level access policy for per-viewer data filtering: `{ version: 1, field, default, rules, queries? }`. `queries` maps a name to `{ connection, provider, endpoint, params }` — the Data Platform queries scoped viewers may run.

message.description: Optional change note for this version, shown in the version history. When a new version is published without one, a short "what changed" note may be generated in the background (`message_source: ai`), unless the workspace turned off `ai.version_summaries`.

subdomain_url.description: Preferred share URL for workspace artifacts (https://{workspace}.shareout.site/{slug}/). Omitted for personal artifacts.

editor_readiness.description: Advisory HTML editor-readiness profile (HTML artifacts only). Never blocks publishing.

visibility_downgraded.description: True when the page came out more private than requested (instance policy, account without a verified email, public-artifact cap, or a moderation hold). A publish with no `visibility` counts as asking for public.

notice.description: Human-readable reason the publish was adjusted (governance, caps, email gate, instance policy).

approval_required.description: Present when workspace policy requires teammate approval before going open.

required.description: Number of approvers the requester must nominate.

request_id.description: Correlation id (also the `X-Request-Id` header). Quote it in support tickets.

reason.description: Finer cause under `code`. For `UNAUTHORIZED`: missing, invalid, revoked or expired.

hint.description: What to do next, in plain words.

support.description: Present on 5xx — how to reach a human.

moderation_status.description: Safety review state for open visibility.

current_version.description: version_no live on the production deployment (reflects rollback).

live_message.description: Change note of the live version (detail endpoint only).

live_message_source.description: `author` when the publisher wrote live_message, `ai` when it was generated (detail endpoint only).

can_edit.description: Caller may update the artifact and use the editor (detail endpoint only).

can_delete.description: Caller may move the artifact to Trash (detail endpoint only).

can_manage_comments.description: Caller may change the artifact's comment settings, such as guest comments (owner; detail endpoint only).

pages.description: HTML pages of the live version, entrypoint first (detail endpoint only; present when there are 2+).

entrypoint.description: The live version's entrypoint (detail endpoint only; present with `pages`).

Visibility.description: 'unlisted' was retired 2026-07 — still accepted as input and treated as 'public'.

version.description: Version number to verify, with all of its files. Defaults to the live version.

full_page.description: Screenshot the whole page height (up to 4000 px) instead of the first screen.

live.description: Whether the verified version is the one viewers get now.

status.description: `fail` = at least one error, `warn` = warnings only, `pass` = neither, `partial` = the page was not rendered (see `partial_reason`) and only the source was checked.

issues.description: Errors first, then warnings, then notes (at most 60).

entrypoint.description: The file this view rendered (the phone renders the mobile entrypoint when there is one).

design.description: Fonts, accent colors, longest line and missing meta tags, from the first viewport.

path.description: Relative path with "/" between folders. No "..", no leading "/", no backslash, no empty or "." segments (e.g. "a//b", "./x"), no control characters, at most 512 characters. An unsafe path is rejected with 400 `INVALID_PATH`; the `hint` names it.

icon.description: Data URL or absolute URL to a PNG icon.

AgentConfig.description: Turns on the visitor chat agent.

rule.description: Stable id, e.g. `js_error`, `storage_blocked`, `request_failed`, `api_error`, `csp_blocked`, `horizontal_overflow`, `small_tap_targets`, `broken_image`, `blank_page`, `absolute_path`, or an axe-core rule id such as `image-alt`.

where.description: `file:line:col`, a CSS selector, or a URL.
